title: Localize the widget header's active-quest count and fix its pluralization
description: Replace the manually-pluralized template with context.resources.getQuantityString() using the new quest_count_active plural resource. context is captured by closure from the enclosing provideGlance(context, ...) parameter.
acceptance_criteria: The hardcoded string template is replaced by context.resources.getQuantityString(R.plurals.quest_count_active, activeTasks.size, activeTasks.size)
